scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports=@(3001,5173,5019,5020); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($conns){$conns | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }}}"
